title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller
Location: Rochdale
Salary: £28,000 - £32,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday - 35 hours per week
Contract: Permanent, Full Time
Working Pattern: Office Based

Client Details

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Credit Controller to join a growing team based in Rochdale.

As a Credit Controller, you will support the day-to-day Credit Control function, helping to ensure outstanding debts are managed effectively and payments are received on time.

Description

The key responsibilities of a Credit Controller will be:
- Assisting with the management of a shared inbox and providing day-to-day support to the Credit Control function.
- Assessing client credit status and ensuring appropriate credit limits are set and maintained.
- Proactively managing overdue accounts and carrying out effective debt recovery procedures.
- Following up with customers regarding outstanding payments and resolving queries where required.
- Building and maintaining positive customer relationships to support timely payment and ongoing business.
- Producing regular reports on receivables, outstanding debts and overdue accounts for senior management.
- Working closely with the wider finance team to support cash flow forecasting and minimise credit risk.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all credit control activity is completed efficiently and in a timely manner.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller will have:
- Previous experience in credit control or accounts receivable.
- A self-motivated and proactive approach.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent problem-solving abilities.
- Strong numerical skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confident using Microsoft Excel
- The ability to work effectively as part of a team while also working independently.
- Excellent organisation and time management skills.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Job Offer
- £28,000 - £32,000 salary
- Generous annual leave
- Free on-site parking
- Discounted health plan available
- Company discounts
- Permanent, full-time employment
- 35 hours per week
- A supportive office-based working environment

title: Assistant Finance Business Partner (Treasury & Business Planning)
description:
Assistant Finance Business Partner (Treasury & Business Planning)

Rochdale

36,400

Contract: Fixed Term Contract until December 2027
Hours: 36.25 hours per week

Are you an ambitious finance professional looking to develop your career in treasury, business planning and commercial finance?

Rochdale Boroughwide Housing is looking for an Assistant Finance Business Partner (Treasury & Business Planning) to join our Finance & Procurement team on a fixed-term basis until December 2027, to cover maternity leave.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone currently studying towards a professional accountancy qualification who wants to gain valuable experience in treasury management, financial planning, and regulatory reporting. You'll work alongside senior finance colleagues to support the delivery of robust financial plans that help shape the future of our organisation.

RBH's smart working policy is all about giving you the flexibility to work wherever and whenever you, or the business need. We don't offer remote contracts, all colleagues are required to live within a reasonable commutable distance of Rochdale.

About the Role

As Assistant Finance Business Partner (Treasury & Business Planning), you will support the Finance Manager (Treasury & Business Planning) in providing high-quality treasury and business planning services across RBH.

Working with colleagues across the organisation and external stakeholders, you'll help develop and maintain business plans, support treasury reporting and cash flow management, contribute to regulatory returns, and ensure financial information is accurate, timely and insightful. This role offers exposure to key strategic activities that support the long-term financial sustainability of RBH.

What You'll Be Doing as our Finance Business Partner
- Supporting the preparation and maintenance of RBH and subsidiary business plans using Business Planning software.
- Assisting with financial modelling, stress testing and sensitivity analysis to support strategic decision-making.
- Supporting quarterly and annual submissions to the Regulator.
- Preparing month-end treasury accruals, reconciliations and interest calculations.
- Monitoring treasury performance, supporting covenant compliance reporting and preparing monthly management information.
- Assisting with cash flow forecasting and liquidity monitoring to ensure effective treasury management.
- Supporting the production of reports for Board, Committees, Executive Leadership Team, lenders and regulators.
- Maintaining treasury records, including banking mandates, signatories and securitisation information.
- Preparing treasury-related returns and reports for lenders and external stakeholders.
- Reviewing bank reconciliations and monitoring outstanding transactions.
- Supporting internal and external audit requirements.
- Raising purchase orders and administering treasury-related expenditure.
- Providing cover and support for wider Treasury and Business Planning activities as required.

About You

You will be a motivated and detail-oriented finance professional with a passion for delivering excellent financial services and building strong working relationships.

You will have:
- Experience working within a finance, accounting or business planning environment.
- Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial information.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets and financial models.
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to both finance and non-finance colleagues.
- Experience maintaining financial records, controls and reconciliations.
- A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to contribute to service improvements and new initiatives.

Qualifications
- Actively studying towards a recognised professional accountancy qualification such as ACCA or CIMA.

Why Join RBH?

This is an excellent opportunity to broaden your experience within a supportive and forward-thinking finance team. You'll gain exposure to treasury, business planning, financial modelling and strategic finance activities while contributing to decisions that make a real difference to our customers and communities.

We are committed to supporting professional development and helping colleagues reach their full potential in a collaborative and inclusive environment.

What Do We Have to Offer You?

In addition to a competitive salary, you will benefit from:
- 30 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays (pro-rata)
- Flexible and smart working arrangements
- Healthcare cashback plan, virtual GP access and subsidised gym membership
- Employee Assistance Programme available 24/7
- Paid volunteering days
- Enhanced family-friendly policies
- Plus so much more

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

RBH is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and supported. We operate a Guaranteed Interview Scheme for applicants who declare a disability, as defined by the Equality Act 2010, and meet the role's minimum requirements as set out in the advert and role profile.

title: Service Coordinator
company: Adullam Homes Housing Association - Agency - Permanent
description:
Could you in our missing piece?

Adullam has opportunities available to join our support team in Bury as a Service Coordinator.

About the role Service Coordinator
- The main purpose of this role is to provide support to people with multiple and complex needs as part of a service for those who have lost their home or been rough sleeping.
- You will help a service user to develop the skills needed to move on into independent living/permanent housing via a person-centred support package that is tailor made to suit the needs of everyone accessing the service.
- The role works on a rota to contribute to the staffing of a 24-hours-a-day service.
- The role is full time of 37.5 hours per week. The shift pattern is 7.5 hours a day between the hours of 8am and 8.30pm weekdays, with an occasional weekend shift (currently one every 3 weeks) to deliver activities and some elements of the service outside of 'normal working hours'.
- You will be expected to work within the organisation's charitable aims and objectives and contribute to the maintenance and development of the Association's values, culture, and ethos.

About you

We are looking for a Service Coordinator with:
- Experience of managing a caseload of service users.
- An awareness of issues relating to vulnerable individuals and those that have faced multiple disadvantages.
- Experience in helping others understand their goals and helping them to achieve an outcome.
- Skills in recording and reporting case notes via an online Customer Relationship Management system.
- Experience of working within safeguarding policies and procedures and of identifying, monitoring, and reporting safeguarding concerns.
- A flexible, resilient, thoughtful, therapeutic approach to working with people.
- Practical skills to support service users in activities of daily living required for independence.
- An ability to motivate and empower service users to have greater control and choice over their life and opportunities.
- An ability to demonstrate our values and behaviours and work within our Christian ethos.

Although lived experience is not essential, it is welcomed as part of our workforce. Adullam understands that lived experienced means people have valuable, direct knowledge of how it feels to be in receipt of support services, and what needs to change for the better.

Our offer to you

We are a friendly, people-focused organisation making sure to prioritise and take care of the overall wellbeing of our staff, whilst helping them strive for excellence and reach their full potential. There is training available to help you progress in your chosen career and friendly but focused management that will help oversee your growth.

This role is salaried at £26,890.50 per annum.

In addition to your salary, we also have a list of generous benefits and initiatives that will help support you and your family, both in and outside the workplace.
- 25 days annual leave increasing to 30 days with service, plus Bank Holidays
- Two extra days leave for no unplanned absences each calendar year.
- Access to Thrive app
- Medicash EAP
- Pension Plan
- Death in Service benefit
- Multidimensional wellbeing programmes and family friendly policies for staff
- Refer a friend policy

About us
- Adullam Homes Housing Association Ltd is a Community Benefit Society, an Association created to support vulnerable individuals and households.
- Adullam provides quality accommodation and support as an organisation motivated and informed by our Christian ethos.
- We provide quality housing, deliver tailored support plans, training, education, and employment opportunities to help people achieve stable lives and realise their full potential.

We are passionate about actively encouraging applicants from all cultures, backgrounds, and identities. We are committed to treating our teams fairly and with respect, irrespective of their background, disability, or any other protected characteristic and this starts with our recruitment process.

Adullam Homes Housing Association Ltd. is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and adults accessing our services. We expect all staff, volunteers, and workers to share this commitment. As part of our commitment to safer recruitment, the successful candidate will be subject to an Enhanced with Barred List Adult Only DBS check, scrutiny of employment history, satisfactory pre-employment checks and robust references checks.

Please note applicants must be authorised to work in the UK as we are unable to provide Visa sponsorships.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early and/or make an appointment before the advertised closing date if a suitable candidate is identified.

Adullam Homes Housing Association was created in 1972 to support vulnerable individuals and households. From the simple beginning of a single property in Birmingham, Adullam has expanded into new geographical locations and developed new services.

Over the years it has introduced and run innovative projects to offer tenants, residents and service users opportunities for housing, support, education and training.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Paying up to £28,000 + Benefits - Based in Middleton, North Manchester our client is a successful manufacturing business that are looking for an experienced Sales Administrator to join their supply chain team. After training, this will be a hybrid role working 5 days in every 10 at home/in the office. Working Monday to Thursday 8.30am to 5.00pm and Friday 8.30 to 2.45pm, which includes a 30-minute lunch break each day.

THE JOB

The Sales Administrator is responsible for the accurate and efficient processing of all customer orders and outbound deliveries, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. This role supports the smooth day-to-day management of customer accounts, enabling commercial teams to focus on business growth and development.

Acting as a key link between customers and internal operations, the Sales Administrator ensures clear and timely communication in both directions, translating customer requirements into operational actions while providing customers with accurate updates on orders, deliveries, and any issues. The quality, accuracy, and timeliness of this information are critical to the success of the role.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Order Processing & Coordination: Receive and process customer orders, ensuring all requirements (product, quantity, delivery dates) are clearly understood and communicated across planning, warehousing, and logistics teams. Confirm and acknowledge orders via ERP systems.
- Order Monitoring & Customer Communication: Track order progress, proactively manage delays, and coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues. Keep customers informed of order status and manage delivery schedules.
- Logistics & Distribution Management: Work closely with warehouse and 3 PL partners to coordinate dispatch, collections, and outbound flow of goods, including preparing documentation and ensuring compliance with export regulations.
- Customer Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise with sales, finance, and technical teams to manage enquiries, samples, and technical requests. Investigate and resolve customer complaints efficiently.
- Data Management & Problem Solving: Maintain accurate sales master data and pricing in ERP systems, and troubleshoot operational issues (e.g., transport, availability, credit holds).
- Continuous Improvement & Projects: Drive customer satisfaction improvements and contribute to special projects or assignments delegated by the Supply Chain Manager.

THE PERSON
- At least 5 years of experience in related fields (customer service, sales administration, logistics, or shipping)
- Good level of numeracy and literacy ability
- Strong computer skills, including ERP Systems, Microsoft Word, and Excel
- Able to manage a wide variety of tasks and keep head cool in stressful situations
- A team player
- Able to operate in an independent manner, displaying ownership and taking initiative
- High organisation skills and ability to manage several tasks at the same time
- Ability to prioritise own workload
- Good problem-solving skills

THE BENEFITS
- 2.45pm finish every Friday
- Onsite parking
- 25 days holiday + the bank holidays
- Company pension.
- We Care Plan offering 24/7 access to GP s, mental health support, and a get fit programme.
- Company performance based annual bonus.
- Access to free fruit, tea, coffee, and other refreshments daily.

title: Payroll Administrator
company: Hays Accounts and Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

- Processing weekly and monthly payrolls from start to finish.

- Proven experience processing end-to-end payroll
- Strong knowledge of payroll legislation, HMRC regulations and statutory payments.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills,
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines effectively.
- Good working knowledge of payroll software, Excel and Microsoft Office applications.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We have a 30hour part time permanent position available. Working hours between Monday-Friday 8am-6:30pm. Do you want to have a job that helps people, and work with great colleagues? Then come and be part of our team. As a medical receptionist, and you will work as part of a team that complete the day to day tasks. You will complete daily, weekly, and monthly tasks and will multitask and prioritise to get this work done. You will support clinical staff and problem solve for patients and displace exceptional communication skills. The ideal candidate will have a positive and calm manner, be compassionate, patient and understanding, be well organised and able to work systematically and be able to follow procedures and protocols closely. They will have good IT skills and be brilliant with people. They will need to be able to work in a busy environment, being helpful and efficient when communicating with other staff and patients. Experience in a similar role is preferred. Manage a busy reception, handling patient face to face queries and dealing with incoming phone calls. To use the e-Referral system for referrals to hospitals and other care providers. To scan and file all correspondence into patients medical records using the docman system. To triage all clinical correspondence and workflow necessary documents to clinicians. Code all relevant clinical information into patients medical records. To make, cancel and amend appointments. To establish an effective recall system for patients to include QOF recalls, childhood immunisations, smears and flu vaccinations. To process all insurance and solicitor reports in a timely manner. To process copies of medical requests for patients and insurance companies in a timely manner. To complete all tasks in workflow manager to include deductions, GP2GP etc. To efficiently deal with tasks from GPs, nurses and other staff. Work safely at all times in accordance with Legislative requirements and Practice Policy and Procedures. To promote the ethos and vision of Hope Citadel Healthcare within the practice include staff, visitors and patients; through the provision of quality whole person healthcare. To attend and participate in any meetings required by the company, including practice meetings, and any applicable training.
